info.title: wssp SDK API
info.description: Owner-scoped sandbox control plane. Send `Authorization: Bearer wssp_sdk_…`. Errors use a fixed envelope whose codes come from a stable catalog.

host.not_owned.message: Host is not owned by this credential's owner.

host.agent_access_off.message: Agent access is disabled on this host.

host.node_offline.message: Host node is offline; retry shortly.

host.file_outcome_unknown.message: The host file change was sent but its outcome is unknown; read the file before changing it again.

OPERATION_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED.message: Operation has no supported typed result.

OPERATION_RESULT_EXPIRED.message: Operation result has expired; status remains available.

RESULT_CURSOR_INVALID.message: Result cursor does not match this request.

sandbox.vm_size_unsupported.message: VM size exceeds the target capacity.

sandbox.vm_size_mismatch.message: VM size conflicts with the accepted allocation.

sandbox.disk_below_image.message: The requested disk is smaller than the template image's root disk; request at least the revision's minDiskGiB.

sandbox.metadata_invalid.message: Metadata exceeds the allowed shape or size.

sandbox.name_invalid.message: Sandbox name must be 1-63 lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens, not UUID-shaped and not starting with wssp-.

sandbox.name_taken.message: Another live sandbox already uses this name.

sandbox.egress_policy_invalid.message: Egress policy exceeds the allowed shape or size.

lease_exceeds_policy.message: Requested lease exceeds the allowed maximum.

capacity_wait_exceeds_policy.message: Requested capacity wait exceeds the allowed maximum.

sandbox.key_limit_reached.message: This key's live sandbox limit is reached.

key.self_revoke_forbidden.message: Only a CLI login key can revoke itself; revoke this key on the dashboard.

UNAUTHORIZED.message: A valid SDK bearer key is required.

FORBIDDEN.message: This key cannot perform this action.

CONFLICT.message: The request conflicts with current state.

PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE.message: Request body exceeds the allowed size.

UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE.message: An uncompressed JSON body is required.

sandbox.idempotency_conflict.message: Idempotency key was used for different input.

sandbox.state_conflict.message: Sandbox state conflicts with this action.

sandbox.managed.message: This sandbox is managed by wssp and cannot be used for this action.

sandbox.template_in_use.message: Template is still used by sandboxes that are not deleted.

sandbox.template_image_missing.message: The exact template image is missing on this host.

sandbox.template_unavailable.message: The template revision is not available on any eligible host in this pool.

sandbox.template_image_rejected.message: The host rejected the template image.

sandbox.template_image_unavailable.message: No eligible host has or can fetch this template image.

sandbox.template_store_unavailable.message: The image store cannot keep a capture taken on this host.

sandbox.capture_policy_forbidden.message: The template's image placement forbids this capture.

sandbox.capture_busy.message: A capture is already running for this sandbox or host.

sandbox.disk_evicting.message: The sandbox's cached disk is being evicted; retry the start shortly.

sandbox.restoring.message: The sandbox is being restored; retry once the restore settles.

restore_no_allowed_host.message: No host this restore may use has room for the sandbox.

sandbox.disk_offloaded.message: The sandbox's disk is offloaded to the image store; start the sandbox first.

sandbox.disk_unavailable.message: The sandbox's stored disk cannot be used on this deployment right now.

sandbox.host_forget_unsafe.message: The host still holds sandboxes whose cleanup cannot be proven; forget is refused.

sandbox.image_quota_exceeded.message: The account's image quota is exhausted.

sandbox.pool_policy_changed.message: Pool grace decreased. Review the policy before retrying.

sandbox.host_delete_conflict.message: Host cannot be deleted in its current state.

sandbox.tunnel_link_not_found.message: This sandbox has no such tunnel link.

sandbox.tunnel_port_undeclared.message: The port is not declared for tunnels on this sandbox.

sandbox.tunnel_not_ready.message: The tunnel is not connected yet; retry shortly.

sandbox.tunnel_quota.message: The account's tunnel limit is reached.

sandbox.tunnel_ports_limit.message: A sandbox declares at most 8 tunnel ports.

TRANSFER_EXPIRED.message: Transfer content has expired; the receipt is still available.

TRANSFER_NOT_READY.message: The file capture is not complete; poll the operation.

RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE.message: The requested byte range cannot be satisfied.

OUTPUT_EXPIRED.message: Command output has expired; the operation status is still available.

webhook.event_expired.message: Webhook event is too old to redeliver.

template.build_disabled.message: Template builds are unavailable on this server.

template.build_no_builder.message: No builder host can run this build.

template.build_concurrency.message: The account is running its maximum number of builds.

template.build_minutes_exhausted.message: The account's build minutes for this month are used.

template.build_context_required.message: A recipe with COPY needs contextSha256 and contextBytes.

template.build_context_too_large.message: The build context exceeds the allowed size.

template.build_context_mismatch.message: The uploaded build context does not match its SHA-256.

template.build_egress_mode_unavailable.message: This egress mode is not available for template builds yet.

template.community_key_scope.message: Community templates need a key that can see every template and revision.

template.community_unavailable.message: No tested community image is available right now.

template.community_managed.message: This community template is managed by wssp.

credential.in_use.message: Every matching login instance is in use.

credential.needs_login.message: No matching login instance is ready; log in or upload a value.

credential.unavailable.message: CLI logins are not available on this server.

credential.repin_blocked.message: The login has live leases, recoverable residue or pending captures; it cannot be re-pinned now.

credential.repin_confirm_erase.message: Re-pinning erases proxy values; confirm with the login's name.

credential.value_invalid.message: The login value does not match its definition.

credential.definition_corrupt.message: The stored login definition does not match its digest.

credential.busy.message: The login instance is held by a running sandbox or a login session.

credential.spec_too_large.message: The sandbox's login specification is too large.

credential.pending_drain.message: The sandbox's host has not yet settled its login captures; retry shortly.

credential.recovery_required.message: The sandbox's disk holds a login value that must be recovered first; start the sandbox or force-release the login.

credential.capture_in_progress.message: A login is being installed, captured or recovered on this sandbox; capture it once that settles.

credential.host_forbidden.message: A login attached to this sandbox is not allowed on that host.

credential.env_conflict.message: The login's environment variables collide with the sandbox's environment or another attached login.

credential.path_conflict.message: The login's files overlap the files of another login attached to this sandbox.

credential.proxy_not_enabled.message: Proxy-mode logins can only be attached to a sandbox created with one.

credential.not_attached.message: That login is not attached to this sandbox.

credential.already_attached.message: That login is already attached to this sandbox.

credential.login_needs_consent.message: None of your own hosts can run this login; allow a foreign host for this login session to continue.

credential.login_requires_upload.message: This login is initialized by uploading a value, not by a login sandbox.

credential.login_state.message: The login session cannot do that in its current state.

definition.spec_too_large.message: The login definition's paths or proxy settings are too large to dispatch.

definition.schema_version_unsupported.message: The login definition schema version is not supported.

envs.description: Unique POSIX names and string values; limits count UTF-8 bytes of sorted escaped JSON. NUL, malformed Unicode and prototype names are rejected. Stored defaults and create envs reject reserved HOME, SHELL and TERM names.

metadata.description: String metadata; keys use 1–64 UTF-16 units, values at most 1024; canonical JSON at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. NUL, malformed Unicode and prototype-related keys are refused.

timeoutMs.description: Relative lease in milliseconds; 0 means no lease timer where policy allows it. Finite leases are capped at 24 days (2073600000 ms) by policy, or lower by the deployment, host or pool: a larger value fails with 400 `lease_exceeds_policy` carrying `maxTimeoutMs`.

waitForCapacityMs.description: Pool creates only: wait up to this many milliseconds (1000..2073600000) for capacity, or "unlimited". The lease starts at placement.

afterMs.description: Milliseconds the sandbox must stay stopped before its disk is exported (60000 to 2073600000).

offload.description: When a stopped disk is exported to the image store: `on_stop` (default), `after` a delay, or `on_pressure` (only when its host needs the space). Host pressure and `wssp host drain --offload` export early whatever the policy.

maxTimeoutMs.description: Largest finite timeoutMs on this pool's best available path for this key (deployment, host ceilings, pool and membership maximums). Placement may offer less if hosts are offline.

timeoutZero.description: Whether some path in this pool allows timeoutMs: 0 (no lease timer) for this caller.

lease.description: Lease limits for this caller. With a single contributed member, maxTimeoutMs reveals that host's effective ceiling.

preferOwnHosts.description: Placement ranks the requester's own member hosts first (a tier, not a filter).

capacityWait.description: Effective capacity-wait limits for this caller (deployment and pool layers).

name.description: Sandbox name: a lowercase DNS label (1-63 characters of a-z, 0-9 and inner hyphens), unique among the owner's live sandboxes. Not UUID-shaped and not starting with `wssp-`.

expiresAt.description: Requested lease end. 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z means no time limit (timeoutMs: 0).

endAt.description: Lease end the host enforces. 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z means no time limit; see isUnlimitedLeaseEnd.

metadata.description: String metadata; keys use 1–64 UTF-16 units, values at most 1024; canonical JSON at most 8192 UTF-8 bytes. NUL, malformed Unicode and prototype-related keys are refused.

afterMs.description: Milliseconds the sandbox must stay stopped before its disk is exported (60000 to 2073600000).

offloadPolicy.description: When a stopped disk is exported to the image store: `on_stop` (default), `after` a delay, or `on_pressure` (only when its host needs the space). Host pressure and `wssp host drain --offload` export early whatever the policy.

timeoutMs.description: Accepted relative lease. 0 means no lease timer; endAt is then 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z.

commandTimeoutZero.description: Whether command timeoutMs: 0 is accepted: no separate command timer, bounded by the sandbox lease and execution authority. Clients must check this capability before sending zero.

sandboxTimeoutMinMs.description: Smallest finite sandbox timeoutMs. 0 is a separate no-timer sentinel gated by sandboxTimeoutZero.

sandboxTimeoutMaxMs.description: Largest finite sandbox timeoutMs this deployment allows. Hosts, pools and memberships may allow less; see a pool's lease field.

sandboxTimeoutZero.description: Whether this deployment allows sandbox timeoutMs: 0 (no lease timer). A target must also allow it; the far-future endAt 9999-12-31T23:59:59.999Z marks such a sandbox.

reason.description: Why builds are unavailable; null when enabled.

maxMinutes.description: Largest timeoutMinutes one build may request, after the deployment lease clamp (0 when disabled by it).

maxConcurrent.description: Builds this account may run at once (awaiting context included); null is unlimited.

minutesPerMonth.description: Build minutes per UTC month for this account; null is unlimited.

contextMaxBytes.description: Largest COPY context of one build.

contextWaitMaxMs.description: A COPY build's waitForCapacityMs is clamped to this.

openEgress.description: Whether builds may request open egress (mode: open).

capacityWaitMaxMs.description: Deployment maximum waitForCapacityMs; null allows waits without limit, 0 disables waits. Pools may allow less.

capacityQueuePerKey.description: Waiting creates one SDK key may hold across pools; null is unlimited.

capacityQueuePerOwner.description: Waiting creates one account may hold across pools; null is unlimited.

network.description: Egress modes. Omitting `egress` requests open internet; on another user's host that allows only listed destinations the sandbox is placed in allowlist mode with the request's grants (egressModeReason).

commandTimeoutZero.description: Whether command timeoutMs: 0 is accepted: no separate command timer, bounded by the sandbox lease and execution authority. Clients must check this capability before sending zero.
